comment: Palutena's parts shown on demand (A10, scripts/p6/look_parts.py): each a model-part variant of an existing row drawing that row's list plus cut-out cards, two-sided. Corners are in the look's rest model space (y up, she faces +z; the battle camera sees her x axis as depth, so the cards lie across y and z). The wings (her victory poses, win1 and win3: SetModelPartID joint 6 part 1) are the kit's wing image (godwing, its full feathered wing, the island above it cleared), one card a side sweeping up and back from her shoulder blades. The halo (up air, the down taunt, the victory and select poses: joint 12 part 2) is an authored gold ring above her head, two crossed cards: one faces the battle camera, the other the select and Results cameras, which see her from the front. The light pillar is not a part any more (owner playtest 2026-10-14, round 2: her animation turned the hips row's cards behind her): it is an effect in her special file 2 (scripts/p6/p6_gate.py), its atlas look_parts.py's authored:pillar_burst. Owner p6i follow-up: her forward and down smash draw rigged wings of their own (an effect in her special file 2, scripts/p6/p6_wings.py), not these cards.
